question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 A 组：捷克 vs 南非（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group A: Czechia vs South Africa (90-minute three-way result)
one_liner_cn: Elo 差 223 分让捷克明显占优，但切尔尼伤缺与南非的阵容磨合让比赛仍有变数，捷克胜率约六成。
one_liner_en: A 223-point Elo gap makes Czechia clear favourites, but Cerny's injury and South Africa's cohesion keep the Czech win probability around 60%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 评分捷克 1740（第 35）对南非 1517（第 80），差距 223 分，统计基线明显倾向捷克。
key_reasons.en: Elo ratings: Czechia 1740 (rank 35) vs South Africa 1517 (rank 80), a 223-point gap that tilts the statistical baseline clearly toward Czechia.

key_reasons.cn: 捷克头号创造者切尔尼因伤缺席整届世界杯，进攻创造力受损，是小幅下调捷克胜率的主因。
key_reasons.en: Czechia's most influential creator Vaclav Cerny misses the entire tournament through injury, the main reason for a small downgrade of the Czech win probability.

key_reasons.cn: 南非 26 人名单延续预选赛班底，19 人来自国内联赛、配合成熟，但旅欧球员仅 5 人，上限有限。
key_reasons.en: South Africa's 26-man squad keeps the qualifying core: 19 domestic-based players form a cohesive unit, though only five are based in Europe, capping the ceiling.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat 60.8/22.4/16.8; bounded evidence adjustment of -2pp Czechia (+1pp draw, +1pp South Africa) for the Cerny injury and South Africa's squad cohesion, capped at +/-8pp. No market data used anywhere.
